scope: All 24 published A-D findings plus nine independently reproduced product findings discovered while closing the audit.

decision.selected_release_configuration: student-tutor-r1-local-candidate-v1 with bounded T1-v1 and deterministic T0 rollback
decision.rationale: Runtime defects are corrected prospectively, but the post-hoc reference rewrite, false revision, missing predecessor record, and profile mismatch prevent confirmation 013 and its local qualification from supporting a current V2.1 release selection. Historical artifacts remain unchanged and visible.
decision.next_step: Compare the repaired common runtime under preregistered A/B/C autonomy architectures and economical engine allocations on fresh flow-independent evidence.

findings.evidence: Governed deterministic construction now shares DeterministicActionRouterV2 and has a factory regression test.
Proactive generation now evaluates the approved objective/evidence contract rather than a synthesized instruction.
Configuration fails closed unless the evidence-set generator uses question-targeted-ambiguity-safe-v2.
clarify-request is durably normalized to clarify.
Attempted provider calls are read from the durable model-call ledger; failure fallback no longer reports zero calls.
Operations metrics expose the separate autonomy planner budget snapshot.
Page fallbacks are removed before limiting results and only when a precise region actually contains the fallback.
Canonical-source verification is limited to the deterministic evidence-set generator; live generators use contiguous-quote verification.
The post-hoc Keep remains historical but is revoked as release-selection evidence.
The false execution revision is not repaired in place; the affected correction is revoked as current evidence.
The missing 012 correction chain is disclosed and the dependent 013 selection is not reused.
The mismatched profile-bound release record is superseded; local Compose returns to the hash-bound T1-v1/T0 configuration.
Live planner failures now fail closed to no-action, matching the simulation safety contract; affected confirmation evidence is retired.
The E0 implementation again delegates to the historical deterministic generator under its unchanged identity.
011/012 cannot authorize prospective selection; the successor uses typed, hash-verified manifests.
The factual adapter applies canonical verification only to deterministic engines.
The runbook names the profile explicitly and states that the historical governed record cannot authorize startup.
Staging qualification now binds planner mode and evidence-gate identity in addition to profile and generator.
Local R1 release-critical mode, gate, profile, planner, and qualification values are literal Compose pins.
The .claude dirty-worktree carve-out was removed from both affected runners.
A real question-targeted gate/evidence-set generator integration test covers the prior abstain path.
A positive governed staging configuration test binds planner, gate, profile, and qualification.
Compose tests require literal safe release pins rather than override expressions.
Provider-failure tests assert the persisted trace records one attempted generation call.
Crash recovery after inbox materialization recognizes the existing delivery and cannot duplicate it.
Plural evidence regions receive a deterministic primary source_chunk_id.
Paused/killed policy wake-ups are excluded before the due-work LIMIT and resume normally.
Independent scoring rejects duplicate or non-contiguous state revisions.
Restart comparison hashes every scoped durable entity, not four representative IDs.
Learning-gap proposal IDs are stable and unknown/stale proposal reviews fail closed.
Autonomous outcome and provider-accounting timestamps use the injected job clock.
Professor course refreshes use a monotonic request sequence so stale responses cannot overwrite the active course.
Professor autonomy history is bounded and learner evidence is fetched through course-batch endpoints instead of N+1 requests.

limitations: This closure verifies software and evidence integrity; it does not select a new autonomous architecture.
The audit report's unverified candidates were never accepted findings and are not silently promoted into this finding count.
No provider-backed, human, professor-fidelity, usability, or learning-outcome evaluation was performed.
